info.name: Flipturn Access IDs Departure Times API
Sync departure times for a vehicle

items.docs: Atomically replace all future departure times for a single vehicle (identified by vehicleVin or vehicleId, not both). Past departures in the request are skipped; existing past departures are left unchanged.

info.name: Sync departure times for multiple vehicles

items.docs: Sync departure times for multiple vehicles in a single request. Each vehicle is processed independently.
